node.statement: Apply lem-routef-upsilon-normalization-closeness to the same (W_RF,S) and the particular triple (Delta',Delta,Upsilon').  It produces a UCP map Upsilon:B(C^n)=M_n->B supplied from exactly that triple by that lemma.  No witness has been reselected, so the B,S,Delta',Delta,Upsilon',Upsilon obtained in nodes 1.3-1.5 have precisely the common-provider relations and map types required by node 1.
